what: Design API mapping specifies DestReuseBinary with Row broadcast for gamma, but DestReuseBinary takes a plain InputSpec with no BroadcastDim; also design lists a separate cb_accum although Accumulate::at(cb, i) uses the output CB as accumulator, and design shows pre-DataflowBuffer helper signatures (square(shape,in,out) with raw ids).
suggest: Planner should check chain.hpp/reduce Accumulate semantics before binding the mapping; note DestReuseBinary has no bcast and that Accumulate target == output CB.

what: Design says set UnpackToDestFp32 for all fp32 CBs, but FPU consumers (square/reduce/bcast mul) cannot read such CBs; contradicts tilize_helpers/reduce docs. Also pre-commit hooks need network installs and time out in the sandbox.
suggest: Drop the blanket UnpackToDestFp32 rule for FPU chains; document --no-verify or pre-installed hook envs.
